Name: The Museum Pays - Get Paid Donating to the Museum
Author: Exonika
Description:
[img]https://i.postimg.cc/QCGm4JYf/Banner-NEW.png[/img]
​
This mod adds a new way to get paid in the valley and that's by your own donations to the museums, for every 10 donations to the museum you'll now receive a letter the next day with thanking you 1000/5000/10000 gold.
​​
​
​
[img]https://i.postimg.cc/jqww5JgN/features.png[/img]

[b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]GMCM[/url] is recommended for configuration.﻿[/b]

This mod has three configuration options in regard to the amount you will receive.
​
[list]
[*]1000: you will only receive 1000 gold for every ten donations.
[*]5000: you will only receive 5000 gold for every ten donations
[*]10000: you will only receive 10,000 gold for every ten donations.
[/list]​
​

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/Nf80981y/how-to-install.png[/img]
​
[list=1]
[*] [b]Install [/b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]
See the [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Player_Guide/Getting_Started]player's guide to modding[/url]﻿ (or to skip [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Player_Guide/Getting_Started#Getting_started]install steps[/url]﻿).
‌
[*][b]Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿[/b]
Unzip Content Patcher and move the unzipped file to [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].﻿
‍
[*][b]Download the mod's .rar/.zip file[/b]
‍
[*][b]Unzip the compressed file[/b]
‍‍
[*][b]Move the unzipped file to your Mods folder[/b]
Your Mods folder should be located in [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].




[/list][img]https://i.postimg.cc/rs1q4ct6/credits.png[/img]
